profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
I am passionate about user experience, accessibility standards, and clean code. My approach to frontend development is informed by many years of design training and experience. I have a deep interest in psychology and enjoy learning about how people interact with and use web applications. By working closely with designers, researchers, and product managers I strive to be an evangelist for all users. I create experiences that are elegant, performant and responsive. I balance business goals with the needs of customers while creating clarity around feature requirements. Most of all I love designing and implementing software.

Increasingly I have been devoting time to furthering my knowledge of software architecture, and systems design. I am continuously looking for new opportunities to learn and grow.

positions.title: Web Designer / Developer
positions.description:
Maintained multiple eCommerce websites (Drupal & Wordpress) for a variety of clients 

Managed communication with an external back-end development team

Lead Front-end developer within the marketing department 

Designed and developed email and landing page lead generation campaigns

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description:
Worked within the marketing team to create a variety of materials including direct mail, emails and faxes for various clients specifically targeting dentists. 

Worked closely with clients to create new branding, packaging and or logo design.

Involved with website development.

Created print and web advertising.

Design and layout of the “DOCS Digest,” a multiple page membership publication for our client DOCS Education.

positions.title: Design Editor
positions.description:
Updated and redesigned a number of the Daily Record’s special section publications as well as many tab sheet inserts.

Closely involved with the Daily Record’s newspaper redesign that took place in the Fall 2007.

Involved with the daily layout of the newspaper while under the pressure of tight deadlines.

Responsible for quickly completing the layout of multiple-page, magazine-style publications in a short allotment of time.

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description:
Worked with many clients from different departments and centers across campus to successfully design publicity pieces.

Designed collateral pieces, which were sent to print at an off site printing firm.

 Worked in collaboration with the Publicity Center staff to create the “Hype” (a quarterly tab sheet newspaper detailing ongoing events happenings in a given quarter).

Balanced multiple projects simultaneously while keeping up with a range of strict deadlines.

projects.title: Listo
projects.description: This is a social media app that is designed to group 4 members together based on their neighborhood and uses foursquare's api to select a random location for a meet up. What makes Listo unique is its flake score which allows users to see how flakey each user is. This ensures that users show up to events.

projects.title: Pantry 2 Plate
projects.description:
Pantry to Plate lets users search and browser recipes filtered by a digital pantry the user populates with ingredients he or she has available in their home.

Pantry to Plate makes calls to the Yummly api and is built on node.js express and postgresql.
